name: v0.29.0
body:
## What's Changed
* fix(mcp): surface tool error messages lost since mcp 2.0 by @Kohei-Wada in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1256
* test(server): cover fix-actual validation for duration and end<start by @Kohei-Wada in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1257
* fix(server): warn on unauthenticated non-loopback bind and bound request sizes by @Kohei-Wada in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1258
* refactor(core): use injected ITimeProvider in the task write path by @Kohei-Wada in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1259
* chore(ci): workflow hygiene — concurrency, typecheck env, mypy configs, pinned publish by @Kohei-Wada in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1260
* fix(server,client): send WebSocket API key in X-Api-Key header by @Kohei-Wada in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1262
* fix(client): close error-handling gaps and fail fast on unreachable servers by @Kohei-Wada in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1263
* refactor(server): drop dead analytics handlers, type period, explicit delete model by @Kohei-Wada in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1264
* perf(core): build optimization summary from the already-fetched tasks by @Kohei-Wada in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1265
* chore(tui): remove stale TCSS selectors by @Kohei-Wada in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1266


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/compare/v0.28.1...v0.29.0
